text:
Rae: Hot take: If it smells like the ocean, don't microwave it at noon. :nose:
Devon: Agreed. The ozone-alarm policy is unforgiving. Also, air fresheners are only emotional support.
Morgan: We need a clear rule: fish = lunchroom after-hours only. Or a very sad lunchbox.
OpsBot: Reminder: Please be considerate in shared spaces. Persistent odors may trigger a community cleanup. :warning:
SnackBot: New poll by Morgan: 'Microwave meat/fish at noon?' 1: Never, 2: Only with lid, 3: Do it proudly. Poll ends in 12h.
Eli: One-liner suggestion for the kitchen sign: "If it could offend a narwhal, don't heat it at 12." :laughing:
Zoe: Also, someone left a half-taco. If you own it, claim it now or it's going to stan the communal shelf.
Rae: Claiming: mine wasn't a taco, it was a taco-shaped memory. RIP.
Devon: I will make a tiny sticky note template: Name | Date | Heat (yes/no) | Emergency contact (for spicy incidents).
Morgan: Can we have 'Microwave Amnesty Friday' where everyone microwaves their questionable leftovers and we all grieve together?
Eli: I'll bring tissues and empathy. Also coffee.
OpsBot: Proposal: add a pinned message with a five-second sniff test guideline and reheating tips. Please upvote in the poll.
Zoe: Quick vote reaction: :one: :two: :three:
Rae: Thanks everyone. Rule extracted: noon microwaving requires consent or an air-tight lid. Closing thread. :v:
